decision: Migrate the reviewed template to native OpenTofu roots
why: The approved design makes Python optional and removes Terraform CLI support

decision: Preserve the local catalog tag object type across the module boundary
why: The first migration plan exposed an object-to-map type change despite equal JSON values; an explicit object conversion restores no-op resource plans
result: dev and prod retain IDs and outputs with no resource changes

decision: Freeze the legacy local fixture in the repository
why: Template-generated repositories and source archives do not retain the old Git commit
result: Git-less dev and prod migration passed

decision: Validate native roots and optional policy commands directly
why: Resource behavior and scanner failure paths need executable evidence
result: 30 roots and 10 modules passed validation/tests; 30 lint and 27 cloud source scans passed; Atlantis configuration and policy commands passed

decision: Allow new resources without invented historical addresses
why: Migration checks apply to frozen old state, while template users must be able to add resources and environments
result: Removed universal move and fixed project-count requirements; extension acceptance and wrong-state rejection passed

decision: Use controlled migration inputs and configurable lifecycle expectations
why: Changing example names and tags is normal template adoption and must not invalidate layout migration proof
result: Git-less customized names/tags passed; added environment/resource passed; wrong state key and changed resource identity rejected
